evidence.title: Grokking the Coding Interview Patterns: 42 Patterns, 500+ Problems

name: Grokking the Coding Interview: Patterns for Coding Questions
summary: Interview prep course on 41 coding patterns, with 671 lessons, in-browser practice problems and worked solutions.
description: Online course that teaches the recurring patterns behind coding interview questions — two pointers, sliding window, tree and graph search, dynamic programming and more — with in-browser editor playgrounds and time/space complexity analysis for every solution. 49 chapters, 90 h of study time, plus a warmup chapter and 34 unlabeled test-your-knowledge problems; solutions are shown in Python, Java, C++, JavaScript, Go and C#.
